description: Traversal (packages/core/docs/mechanic-predicates.md §7): is there a way from here to there, is it open, and may this actor use it — never the path THROUGH it, which is a navmesh query and a host concern (§11). Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/prolog/mechanics/traversal-predicates.ts verbatim, including the pack-local library-free traversal_member/2 and the traversal_goal_met/2 that rebinds an authored requirement to the caller's actor. traversal_link/3 is DIRECTED: a symmetric path is authored as two facts and these rules never silently symmetrise. US-2 of 122-traversal-and-travel added the vehicle half: a ridden entity is an ENTITY with an owner (vehicle_owner/2), a place (at_location/2 — the same predicate every other rule reads), a passenger list (vehicle_occupant/2) and a driver (vehicle_driver/2), and its whole traversal meaning is the mode it lends whoever holds the reins (vehicle_mode/2 → riding_mode/2). §12’s cut of vehicle/1 and vehicle_capacity/2 stands, and speed, handling and buoyancy get no predicates at all (§11). vehicle_not_owned_by/2 is the FACT a theft norm is authored over — whether taking another’s cart is forbidden is forbids/4’s answer, and a vehicle nobody owns is nobody’s to steal. US-3 added fast travel: can_fast_travel/2 is §7's own worked example promoted from an authored can_perform/2 clause to a pack rule, gated on location_discovered/1 (gameplay-predicates.ts's own predicate, declared here rather than re-minted) and on reachable/3. That second gate is what keeps a journey a WORLD operation rather than a teleport — what refuses the walk refuses the journey, so a landslide on the only route refuses it too. Permission stays forbids/4's and elapsed world time stays src/traversal/fast-travel.ts's; neither is a fact, because a save carrying a stale copy of either is how a world stops meaning one thing.

cases.name: traverses-one-open-link-in-a-mode-the-actor-uses
kb: traversal_goal_met(A, Goal) :- Goal =.. [F, _ | Rest], Bound =.. [F, A | Rest], call(Bound).
can_traverse(A, From, To) :- traversal_link(From, To, Mode), \+ traversal_blocked(From, To), movement_mode(A, Mode), \+ (traversal_requires(From, To, Goal), \+ traversal_goal_met(A, Goal)).
reachable(A, From, To) :- reachable_via(A, From, To, [From]).
reachable_via(A, From, To, _) :- can_traverse(A, From, To).
reachable_via(A, From, To, Seen) :- can_traverse(A, From, Mid), \+ traversal_member(Mid, Seen), reachable_via(A, Mid, To, [Mid | Seen]).
riding_mode(A, Mode) :- vehicle_driver(V, A), vehicle_mode(V, Mode).
can_board(A, V) :- vehicle_mode(V, _), at_location(V, L), at_location(A, L), \+ vehicle_occupant(V, A).
can_drive(A, V) :- vehicle_occupant(V, A), \+ (vehicle_driver(V, Other), Other \== A).
vehicle_not_owned_by(A, V) :- vehicle_owner(V, Owner), Owner \== A.
can_fast_travel(A, Dest) :- location_discovered(Dest), at_location(A, Here), Here \== Dest, reachable(A, Here, Dest).

kb: traversal_goal_met(A, Goal) :- Goal =.. [F, _ | Rest], Bound =.. [F, A | Rest], call(Bound).
can_traverse(A, From, To) :- traversal_link(From, To, Mode), \+ traversal_blocked(From, To), movement_mode(A, Mode), \+ (traversal_requires(From, To, Goal), \+ traversal_goal_met(A, Goal)).
reachable(A, From, To) :- reachable_via(A, From, To, [From]).
reachable_via(A, From, To, _) :- can_traverse(A, From, To).
reachable_via(A, From, To, Seen) :- can_traverse(A, From, Mid), \+ traversal_member(Mid, Seen), reachable_via(A, Mid, To, [Mid | Seen]).
riding_mode(A, Mode) :- vehicle_driver(V, A), vehicle_mode(V, Mode).
can_board(A, V) :- vehicle_mode(V, _), at_location(V, L), at_location(A, L), \+ vehicle_occupant(V, A).
can_drive(A, V) :- vehicle_occupant(V, A), \+ (vehicle_driver(V, Other), Other \== A).
vehicle_not_owned_by(A, V) :- vehicle_owner(V, Owner), Owner \== A.
can_fast_travel(A, Dest) :- location_discovered(Dest), at_location(A, Here), Here \== Dest, reachable(A, Here, Dest).
